##### Project general facts

Reportage Bay is a residential resort community that brings the experience of resort living into a place to call home. The masterplan combines townhouses, twin villas and standalone villas within a landscape of parks, recreation spaces and ocean views. Homes range from one-bedroom duplex townhouses to four-bedroom triplex townhouses and villas.

Central parks above and below the cliff create places to spend time outdoors, while a boutique hotel, large swimming pools, children's swimming pools and retail areas contribute to life within the community. Residents also enjoy clubhouses with gyms, children's play areas, a nursery, barbecue areas, outdoor seating and outdoor yoga spaces.

Residences feature private balconies and terraces, central air conditioning and double-glazed windows. Bedrooms include built-in wardrobes, select bedrooms have private bathrooms, and bathrooms are fully tiled with vanity units and mirrors, while satellite and fibre optic connections provide high-speed internet access.

##### Location description and benefits

Barra do Dande is a coastal locality in Dande, Bengo province, on the Atlantic coast north of Luanda, Angola. It is home to Dubai Investments Park Angola, a masterplan that combines residential communities with commercial districts, industry and hospitality.

The Atlantic coast is moments away, and the Barra do Dande Free Trade Zone and the Sonangol Oceanic Terminal are a short drive away. Luanda City Center and the New International Airport are within reach by road.

Parks, recreation areas and planned infrastructure within the wider masterplan support the people who live and work in the area, making the coastal setting attractive to lifestyle buyers and investors alike.
